sheets.prompt: Character design sheet for a science fiction exploration game: the hats of a city built down the walls of a vast vertical shaft, rich families on the sunlit rim and the poor in the dark depths. Four hats, each worn by a head-and-shoulders figure, front and three-quarter view: a rim family's hat of pale lacquered felt with a short stiff brim and a single pastel band, worn with a high collar; a middle-levels worker's soft cap with a short peak, canvas and patched; a bottom-of-the-shaft hood of layered rags close round the face, lantern-soot on the cloth; a leather goggle band worn over close-cropped hair. Every hat sits close on the skull, no taller than the head, brims no wider than the shoulders, one clear silhouette each, readable from far away. Moebius science-fiction, Franco-Belgian ligne claire, exquisite fine pen contours, sparse delicate hatching only in shadows, luminous flat pastel gouache colours, rose, lavender and pale blue on the rim, rust and soot grey below, restrained cream paper grain, clear readable construction, no lettering. Avoid: photorealism, 3d render, text, watermark, lettering, labels, costume party.
